title: Poppler 21.01.0 through 26.11.0 contains a time-of-check time-of-use race condition in…
description: Poppler versions 21.01.0 through 26.11.0 contain a time-of-check to time-of-use (TOCTOU) race condition in the FormWidgetSignature::signDocument() function. This flaw allows local attackers with write access to the output file or directory to manipulate the PDF file between the signing check and the actual signing operation, resulting in valid signatures on altered content. The vulnerability has a medium severity rating with a CVSS score of 4.4.
